g.text: SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK, not new public records. Null denominators are 250 per batch size, with 95% Wilson intervals. Grid denominators are 480 per batch
size: equal weight to all 12 fixed cells, with stratified bootstrap intervals that resample streams within each cell. PSI and KS are paired,
standalone methods; their union is not a 5% monitor. Intervals do not certify a universal false-alert rate. The paired contrast is retained in
